newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals mixed on higher state offerings.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals mixed on higher state offerings.

text.p: Indian copper and nickel prices fell on Tuesday while other base metals were quiet in narrow trade, dealers said.
Ready copper fell by 50 rupees to 11,800 rupees per quintal on higher offerings by the state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd and sluggish industrial demand. It fell by 50 rupees on Monday.

Nickel lost 200 rupees to 38,600 rupees on unloading by importers against sliding global prices. It was down by 400 rupees on Monday. Aluminium was steady at 7,450 rupees, zinc at 6,325 rupees and lead at 5,000 rupees, respectively, in limited activity. Tin was steady at 35,700 rupees.
